'''Doron Lamb''' (born November 6, 1991)<ref>{{cite web|url=http://espn.go.com/mens-college-basketball/player/_/id/51543/doron-lamb|title=Doron Lamb Stats, News, Videos, Highlights, Pictures, Bio — Kentucky Wildcats — ESPN|accessdate=April 2, 2012}}</ref> is an American [[college basketball]] player at the [[University of Kentucky]]. He is playing his sophomore season for the [[2011–12 Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball team|2011–12 Kentucky Wildcats]]. He plays [[Basketball positions#Backcourt (guards)|guard]]. Lamb was born in [[Queens, NYC]]. He graduated from [[Oak Hill Academy (Mouth of Wilson, Virginia)|Oak Hill Academy]].<ref name="ukathletics">{{cite web|url=http://www.ukathletics.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/lamb_doron00.html|title=Doron Lamb Profile — Kentucky Wildcats Official Athletic Site|accessdate=April 2, 2012}}</ref> At High school he received McDonald's All-America and Jordan Brand Classic All-America honors.<ref name="ukathletics" /> In April 2012, Doron declared for the [[2012 NBA Draft]] along with teammates ([[Anthony Davis (basketball)|Anthony Davis]], [[Marquis Teague]], [[Terrence Jones]], and [[Michael Kidd-Gilchrist]].<ref>{{citeweb|url=http://espn.go.com/nba/draft2012/story/_/id/7825727/kentucky-wildcats-starting-five-declares-nba-draft
|title=UK's starting five opts for draft|date= 18 April 2012|work=ESPN|accessdate=30 May 2012 }}</ref>
